## Description

The safety checks read the patient context: pregnancy and gestation (NSAIDs from 20 weeks severe), the latest weight no older than one month for a child (dose per kg and per day, worked out in mg and, for a liquid, in mL; over the maximum is severe), the latest eGFR (NSAIDs and metformin thresholds), and age 65 or over (a small Beers subset as moderate). Missing context (no weight, no eGFR) is reported as "not checked" with the reason, never as safe. The rule set version is raised and recorded with each check and override.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A seeded set (ibuprofen at 24 weeks, paracetamol 15 mg/kg at 14.2 kg = 213 mg = 8.9 mL of 120 mg/5 mL, diclofenac tablets with eGFR 52 and losartan, diazepam at 76) gives the expected finding in every case (automated test).
- [ ] **AC2.** A child dose without a weight from the last month is not checked, and says so.
- [ ] **AC3.** Each new finding is mutation checked: the test fails when the rule is removed.
- [ ] **AC4.** shortcut: a curated pilot rule set waiting for the clinical safety reviewer (MDV-P2-028); a licensed knowledge base later.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
